rationaleAppend: Split-pair extension (isaiah-woh wave I-4): at Isa 16:5, wᵉhûḵan baḥeseḏ kissēʾ wᵉyāšaḇ ʿālāyw beʾĕmeṯ, ḥeseḏ and ʾĕmeṯ stand in parallel cola and are not the bound formula ḥeseḏ wᵉʾĕmeṯ. The solitary entry governs such split pairs: ḥeseḏ is 'kindness' ('a throne shall be established in kindness') and ʾĕmeṯ 'truth' ('in truth'), and chesed-v-emet-steadfast-love-and-truth (which keeps chesed untranslated) is reserved for the bound formula. This follows the split-pair precedent recorded in tzedakah-u-mishpat-justice-pair. ASV 'lovingkindness', JPS 1917 'mercy' and NJPS 'goodness … faithfulness' (checked) are reported in the Isaiah commentary.
isaiah-woh wave I-4: territorial 'land' at Isa 16:1 (mōšēl-ʾereṣ 'the ruler of the land') and 16:4 (min-hāʾāreṣ 'out of the land', of Moab's territory).

isaiah-woh wave I-4: 'vineyards' at Isa 16:10 (ûḇakkᵉrāmîm 'and in the vineyards'), in the lament for the vine of Sibmah; karmel in the same verse is 'the fruitful field', as elsewhere in the Isaiah overlay chapters (10:18; 29:17; 32:15-16), and is not governed by this entry.
